title: Add phase-boundary decision tree to routing-and-contracts.md and verify-the-claim to bee-shaping Qualify
action: Two skill-source edits under bee-writing-skills discipline (edit skills/ sources, never the vendored .claude/skills/ copies), then re-render the vendored trees. (A) skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md, per CONTEXT.md D8, adapted from /home/thanhsmind/projects/AI/mattpocock-skill/skills/engineering/ask-matt/PHASE-BOUNDARIES.md (read it; rewrite in bee contract voice, never copy): add a compact 'Phase-boundary moves' subsection near the session-care/handoff material — at a phase boundary evaluate five moves IN ORDER, first yes wins: (1) continue in-session when the next phase needs this one as a primary source or budget remains; (2) fresh start when everything in-session is disposable — cheapest, but an irreversible discard; (3) handoff only for a genuinely new place or person (new session boundary, new checkout, another agent) — that list is the whole clause; (4) subagent when the piece is scoped enough to run away-from-keyboard; (5) compact LAST — every move but continue converts primary sources into lossy summaries, and compaction's failure mode is a fresh session confidently wrong about a decision the summary flattened; tie into the existing 65%-context handoff rule as the procedure behind it, not a replacement. Keep it under ~15 lines; do not renumber or disturb neighboring contract sections. (B) skills/bee-shaping/SKILL.md Qualify, per D9: extend step 1 (evidence gathering) with two sentences — a bug-shaped item gets its claim verified by reproducing it (or recording the failed attempt as evidence) before any verdict; the redundancy/duplicate check searches decisions and backlog by domain concept, not by the request's wording. Match the surrounding sentence rhythm; no new step numbers. Do NOT touch the vendored .claude/skills/ trees — the orchestrator runs the full regen chain (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write) once at wave close per the wave-barrier ack.
goal: Session-care contract gains a decision procedure for context moves; Qualify stops triaging unverified bug claims.
verify: commands.test green (PATH cargo test --release); both edits in surrounding voice; vendored-tree regen deferred to wave close (wave-barrier).
